notes.title: Isolation fix and update here!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

The Isolation fix and update is finally here! The game can now be completed, as well as the addition of a new area! This new area introduces outdoor gameplay. The enemy AI has also been re-located so it doesn't glitch.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Huge update has arrived!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

The largest update for Isolation has finally arrived! It includes many new features. Check the changelist below for further details:

Changelist:    

-Enemy AI
-Hiding system
-Security camera system
-New scare
-The normal camera should now work in all levels
-New pause menu
-FPS counter removed for better immersion
-Other things

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Large update on the horizon!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

In the next update, there is going to be new features. There will be a new floor on level 1, which will increase the sense of exploration. To get to this new floor, there will be an elevator. A new floor material will also be in level 1 with this update.

Isolation will also be put on sale in April.

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Version 1.3 nearing completion!
notes.notes:
Hello,

Version 1.3 of Isolation is nearing completion! In 1-2 days I hope to have completed version 1.3. I will then start developing version 1.4. Version 1.4 should contain enemy AI and then Isolation will be mostly completed.

If you want to, you can join the official Interactive Gaming Studios group here: http://steamcommunity.com/groups/Interactivegamingstudios
